# Select a Template

Please select a risk level:

- [Low risk](?template=low_risk.md) - For changes that are not expected to change the Terraform state.
- [Medium risk](?template=medium_risk.md) - For changes that are expected to change the Terraform state.
- [High risk](?template=high_risk.md) - For changes that depend on some external change outside of the Terraform configuration.
